backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing project briefs per user with access control, allowing authenticated users to save and retrieve their own brief.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file for reference or documentation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting Dawateiqra branding, favicon links, and loading the React app root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes, wraps the app with ThemeProvider, and includes the global Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing the top nav, routed content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with error handling, retry flow, and status-based button UI.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal prompting new authenticated users to enter and save their name before continuing.
frontend/src/components/ProjectBriefForm: Form for creating/editing project briefs with validation, local draft saving, and backend sync when logged in.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Responsive top navigation bar with Dawateiqra logo, route links, auth button, and mobile menu sheet.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status state.
frontend/src/hooks/useProjectBriefBacken: Fetches and saves the caller’s project brief via the backend actor with query invalidation and local success/error state.
Handles localStorage-based loading, saving, and clearing of a project brief draft with BigInt support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update the caller’s user profile and role using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and a warm color theme with light and dark mode variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app by mounting it with query and identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/HelpAboutPage.tsx: Renders a help/about page explaining ProjectBrief features using cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the main form, loads backend brief into the draft, and triggers profile setup when needed.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL and hash parameters, store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and manage persisted parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom fonts, colors, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Describes the project's current scope, issues, required image assets, and existing implemented features with versioned metadata.
